basic_info.description: Highly sought after & elegant full flat Victorian condo that can't be missed! This Cow Hollow home in a 2-unit building flaunts a spacious & beautifully remodeled 3 beds, 2 baths w/ 1,465 sq ft, deck, lush shared yard, storage & 1 car garage. Living & formal dining room w/ fireplaces, large pocket doors to expand an openness, perfect for entertaining at a grandeur scale. French doors off master that open to an expansive private deck, kitchen w/ marble countertops, glass drop chandelier, & stainless steel appliances. Oak hardwood floors & historic period details, crown molding & wainscoting throughout. All located in a walker's paradise that's just steps to the vibrant Union St corridor of shops, restaurants, entertainment, Marina & more!
